title: ThunderPhone: AI Phone Agents
excerpt: Voice AI that nails the calls others fumble, on one integrated stack from 2 cents per minute.
content_html:
Record-setting accuracy,
for calls you can trust.

Big Bench Audio measures how well voice AI models respond to challenging questions. ThunderPhone holds the record, so you can trust it to make fewer mistakes on your calls.

99.4% on Big Bench Audio

ThunderPhoneStorm · Extra Intelligence99.4

Qwen Audio 3.0Realtime Plus99.2

Qwen3.5 OmniPlus Realtime98.7

Step-Audio R1.1Realtime97.6

2–10× cheaper than the alternatives.

At every level of intelligence, ThunderPhone is the most cost-effective option on the market.

Any call, any channel, any language.

Whether your calls are customer support, scheduling, pre-sales, or more, ThunderPhone can make them run smoothly.

Inbound & outbound

Place or receive calls, or run bulk outbound campaigns with pacing and retries. TCPA-compliant cold outbound available with ThunderHuman.

Phone, web, or app

Runs over real telephony (HD Voice supported) or embedded in your site or app.

40+ languages

Understands accents and mixed-language calls, switching languages mid-conversation.

Ready for the real world.

ThunderPhone is optimized for the details that make or break real-world calls — and built for the requirements of healthcare, the EU, and more.

See enterprise options

HIPAA & GDPR compliant

BAA and DPA available at no extra charge.

Visit our trust center

Native SIP trunking

Connect existing telephony without rebuilding routing.

DTMF capture

Handle keypad input for IVRs and confirmations.

Interruptions & backchannels

Callers can barge in or say “mm-hm” without derailing the agent — and cross-talk and background noise don’t either.

Voicemail & screener detection

Detect and handle voicemail and screeners on outbound.

Transfers

Cold, warm, and human handoff with context preserved.

Knowledge grounding

Agents answer from your documents with built-in retrieval — upload docs, test search, deploy.

Live supervision

Watch live calls and whisper guidance to the AI mid-conversation.

Code, no-code, or white-glove.

From a no-code front end to raw API access and bespoke enterprise deployments, ThunderPhone flexes to fit your needs.

Platform·No-code

Run production agents from a front end built for operators.

Launch and manage production voice agents from a front end built for operators — knowledge bases, A/B experiments, outbound campaigns, AI-graded test calls, live supervision, and one-click integrations included.

Explore the platform

API·Code

The same voice runtime, one POST away.

Build custom workflows directly against the same core voice runtime that powers the platform.

Read the docs

Enterprise·White-glove

Custom solutions for enterprise.

Custom deployments, BYO-LLM via ThunderSocket, data residency options, and per-minute cost targets for high volume.

ThunderPhone fuses multiple transcripts with direct audio-to-LLM input — so addresses, spellings, and mumbles don't turn into wrong answers.

Explore the platform

Easy setup

Incredibly easy to set up.

Prompt, voice & intelligence

Describe the job in plain language, pick a voice, and choose your intelligence level — Spark, Bolt, or Storm.

Connect SIP

Bring your own carrier. A guided wizard detects your trunk and verifies it live — no telecom ticket.

Add integrations

Paste a request and the wizard wires up your CRM, calendar, and APIs — or attach MCP servers and knowledge bases in a click.

Closed-loop improvement

And then it monitors itself.

Watches

Every real call

Each production call is transcribed and scored — no sampling, no review queue.

Flags

What's going wrong

Misheard names, dropped steps, and dead ends surface on their own.

Suggests

The concrete fix

Agent updates automatically proposed so you can review and apply in one click.

Proves

What actually works

A/B experiments split live traffic between agent variants and report the winner.

We built the voice platform we needed.

ThunderPhone was founded by a team of Stanford AI Lab and Y Combinator alumni who have been working on voice AI since 2024.

Automating a demanding use case — car-insurance pre-sales — we found existing platforms fell short on audio understanding and instruction following, causing mistakes to happen on calls that led callers to hang up. And the platforms' prices were much higher than we thought was reasonable.

So we built our own stack from the ground up to nail the car insurance use case. Then, we turned that stack into ThunderPhone to bring higher performance and lower price to the whole industry.

We've handled thousands of production calls to date, and we'd be glad to show you what our system can do for your use case.

Put your hardest calls
on the integrated stack.

ThunderPhone can help you get your calls right even when no other platform can, and save you money while you're at it.

Get started
